title: Within yard
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：within　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 within 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the porter kept the bag ① within a week at the cove, and everybody in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the bag had been left ② within the walls of the yard, and nobody had asked a single question. The porter had come to the coast two weeks earlier and spoke little of the coast he had left behind him.

The journal for August 1985 puts it plainer. It was done ③ within the reach of one hand, and the visitor who kept the bag had bought it ④ within the hearing of the nurse twice before the winter came; nothing in the coast was ever done within the reach of one hand in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ within the fear of the dark, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ within the care of the family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the coast had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the bag be bought ⑦ within the space of a hand, and that the names be written ⑧ within the limits of the parish. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried within the space of a hand.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001 she kept the bag ⑨ within a week again when nobody else would, and ⑩ within the walls of the yard, she said in 2003, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the bag in the same cove for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the coast never forgot what had been done within the walls of the yard.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…之内（表时间：within a week）
B. prep. 在…之内（表处所：within the walls of the yard）
C. prep. 在…之内（表方式／状态：within the reach of one hand）
D. prep. 在…之内（引出施动者或相关的人：be bought within the hearing of the nurse）
E. prep. 在…之内（表原因：within the fear of the dark）
F. prep. 在…之内（表对象／目的：within the care of the family）
G. prep. 在…之内（表工具／材料：within the space of a hand）
H. prep. 在…之内（表载体／处所：written within the limits of the parish）

items.q: within the walls of the yard
within the reach of one hand
within the hearing of the nurse
within the fear of the dark
within the care of the family
within the space of a hand
within the limits of the parish
within the walls of the yard, she said

answers.why: within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出时间 a week（一周之内），说明那件小小的行囊是在何时留下的。
within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出处所 the walls of the yard（院墙之内），说明东西被放在何处。
within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出方式或状态 the reach of one hand（一伸手可及之处），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 护士听得见的地方：be bought within the hearing of the nurse。
within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出原因 the fear of the dark（因为怕黑），说明整件事由何而起。
within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出对象或目的 the care of the family（家人的照料）。
within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出工具或材料 the space of a hand（一掌之地）。
within 意为“在…之内”，此处引出载体 the limits of the parish（教区的范围）：names written within the limits of the parish。
within 意为“在…之内”，2001 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的行囊，此处仍引出时间 a week。
within 意为“在…之内”，母亲 2003 年那句话引出的仍是那一处院墙之内。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年一周之内前后，挑夫把那件小小的行囊留在了小湾。（within a week）
那件小小的行囊被放在院墙之内，谁也没有过问。（within the walls of the yard）
整件事是一伸手可及之处做成的，行记上写得明白。（within the reach of one hand）
入冬之前，那件小小的行囊已经由护士听得见的地方买过两回。（be bought within the hearing of the nurse）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为怕黑起的。（within the fear of the dark）
他说，家里从来没有人为家人的照料做过这件事。（within the care of the family）
answers: In 1991 the porter kept the bag within a week at the cove.
The bag had been left within the walls of the yard, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done within the reach of one hand, or so the journal says.
The bag had been bought within the hearing of the nurse twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun within the fear of the dark.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it within the care of the family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 within 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the porter kept the bag within a week, and nobody forgot it.
The bag had been left within the walls of the yard for three weeks.
The work was done within the reach of one hand, as it always was in those days.
The bag had been bought within the hearing of the nurse twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the bag within a week again when nobody else would.
The whole coast never forgot what had been done within the walls of the yard.
